claims: `scripts/bootstrap/codex-cloud-setup.sh` grows past the 600-line cap (547 → 609); per `docs/pr-checklists/recurring-review-patterns.md:202-204` it must be split in the same PR, and `SCRIPTS_EXEMPTIONS` doesn't exempt it

The new probes skip the existing non-GitHub-origin guard (`codex-cloud-setup.sh:556-557`): `gh repo view` fails when no remote is on GitHub, and under `set -e` setup aborts with gh's raw error and no guidance
The new probes skip the non-GitHub-origin guard: `verify_origin_write_access` would push a probe branch to the non-GitHub remote

The "pull-request API" probe can't catch missing PR write access (`codex-cloud-setup.sh:184-185`): the probe is a GET that succeeds for any valid token on a public repo, while the commit title and `docs/notes/codex-cloud-setup.md:46-47` claim PR read/write verification
Every probe branch triggers a Vercel deployment (`ui-dashboard/vercel.json:7-8`): `deploymentEnabled` doesn't switch off `codex-cloud-write-probe-*`

Cached containers can end up with the wrong Chromium (`scripts/bootstrap/codex-cloud-maintenance.sh:101`): maintenance re-runs `pnpm install` but never runs `playwright install`, so a `@playwright/test` bump fails with "Executable doesn't exist"
Cleanup trap is disarmed exactly when it's needed (`codex-cloud-setup.sh:217-219`): line 218 sets `created=false` before the failed delete path
Probe branch names can collide (`codex-cloud-setup.sh:192`): `$$` PIDs repeat in containers, so a second push reports "Everything up-to-date" and one delete fails, aborting setup
`docs/notes/codex-cloud-setup.md:59-70`: the outbound-access list leaves out the distro apt mirrors that `playwright install --with-deps` and the first `gh` apt attempt need
The failure message at `setup.sh:207-212` blames every push failure on missing Contents permission, though it also appears for rulesets, network errors, and case 2
No tests cover `verify_github_api_capabilities` or the delete-failure path

judge_reasoning.3846756487: Review item 3 says the PR probe is a GET and can't catch missing PR write access, even though docs/notes/codex-cloud-setup.md:46-47 require PR read/write.
judge_reasoning.3846756810: Review item 2 says the new probes skip verify_origin_git_auth's non-GitHub-origin guard. It notes gh repo view fails and the write probe pushes to the other remote.
judge_reasoning.3846756918: Review item 6 says line 218 sets created=false before returning, which disarms the EXIT-trap cleanup exactly when the delete has failed.
judge_reasoning.3846756922: Review item 7 says the timestamp plus $$ branch name can collide because container PIDs repeat, and suggests adding a uuid.
judge_reasoning.3846757143: Not matched. The review never questions creating a real branch or suggests git push --dry-run. Item 4 flags Vercel deployments from probe branches but keeps the mutating approach and proposes a Vercel config fix instead.
judge_reasoning.3846757191: Review item 8, first bullet, says the outbound-access list in docs/notes/codex-cloud-setup.md:59-70 leaves out the distro apt mirrors that playwright install --with-deps needs.

1.why: wc -l shows codex-cloud-setup.sh went from 547 (base) to 609 (HEAD). recurring-review-patterns.md says a file pushed up past the 600-line cap must be split in the same PR, file-size-watchlist.mjs includes scripts/**/*.sh, and SCRIPTS_EXEMPTIONS only lists the agent-autoreview files.

2.why: Same as the known :179 defect. verify_origin_git_auth skips non-GitHub origins (lines 158-161), but the new verify_github_api_capabilities, called at line 556, has no such guard.

3.why: Also the known :179 missing-guard defect. Its stated consequence is doubtful: gh repo view runs first under set -euo pipefail and would abort setup before any push when no remote is on GitHub.

4.why: Same as the known :195 defects. The probe is only a GET on repos/<repo>/pulls, while the docs claim pull-request read/write access.

5.why: vercel.json deploymentEnabled only disables sentry-autofix/*, so probe branches do fire Vercel. That is a side effect of the known :231 defect, which is that the probe creates and deletes a branch on the real origin on every setup run.

6.why: Setup now runs playwright install (line 583), but maintenance.sh only re-runs pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline and never reinstalls browsers. A cached container on a branch that bumps @playwright/test (^1.60.0) keeps the old Chromium.

7.why: The failed-delete branch sets created=false before return 1, which disarms cleanup_probe_ref. Matches the known :242/:243 defects.

8.why: The branch name is codex-cloud-write-probe-$(date +%s)-$$. Matches the known :192 'make the branch name globally unique' defect.

9.why: The outbound-access list in codex-cloud-setup.md (lines 59-70) has no distro apt mirrors. Matches the known 'Document the distribution package source' item at :70.

10.why: The heredoc does name Contents permission for any push failure, but git push only sends stdout to /dev/null, so git's real error on stderr still shows. This is a wording preference, and 'case 2' is never defined.

11.why: codex-cloud-setup.test.sh adds only the playwright on/off, write-success and write-refused cases. Nothing exercises verify_github_api_capabilities or the failed-delete path, and that untested path holds the created=false bug.
